exposure: Underweight, normal, overweight, and obese BMI categories based on World Health Organization criteria
cohort: Pregnant women in Thatta, Pakistan and Nagpur and Belagavi, India
finding: High BMI in early pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of adverse maternal, perinatal, and neonatal outcomes in rural India and Pakistan.
mod_finding: Cesarean/assisted delivery rates were higher among women with higher BMIs.
